description.narrative: (Jamaica): $2,000,000 will be directly attributed to the development of a new clean energy activity. To achieve its objectives, the program will work with multiple stakeholders: national policy makers and planners, utilities, project developers, financial institutions, and end-users. Specifically, USAID/Jamaica's Clean Energy program will establish pre-conditions for clean energy development (policies and planning), optimizing variable renewable integration and reducing losses in the electricity sector, and accelerating private sector clean energy investment. USAID/Jamaica will use a mix of on-the-ground results and higher level enabling environment reform. A breakdown of the clean energy funding by sub-pillar will be determined once the program design is complete (end FY 2015), but will likely focus on renewables, energy efficiency, enabling environment, and LEDS planning/development. Information from the ongoing Intended Nationally Determined Contribution (INDC) support from State Department will feed into Clean Energy activities in the new procurement.
